response.original_title: How do I add a room to my Virgin Voyages Cruise?
response.overview: [Room Addition] How do I add a room to my Virgin Voyages Cruise? To add a room to an existing Virgin Voyages cruise, you cannot do it online through your account portal; instead, you must book a separate new stateroom and call Sailor Services or your travel advisor to link the two reservations.  Steps to Add a Room  Book a Separate Cabin: Purchase a new, separate stateroom either by calling support or booking a new reservation through the Virgin Voyages website.  Contact Customer Service: Call +1-866-259-1002 (US) Virgin Voyages Sailor Services at +1-866-259-1002 (US), or reach out to your travel advisor. Steps to Book and Manage Multiple Cabins  Call or Use an Agent: Book the second cabin by calling +1-866-259-1002 (US) Virgin Voyages or your travel agent
